As vessels grow larger you will find a need for structural 
components. These parts help you to position parts in

tank.
The EAS-4 Strut Connector is the kerbal universe equivalent of duct tape. \nYou can use it in just about any situation to join parts together.
If the connector goes between parts in different stages in a vessel, \nthen it will "break" by design when that stage is activated.
These are especially useful in space station construction.

What goes up does come back down. It is much easier, and more \nefficient, to use parachutes when landing on bodies that have an \natmosphere. Compared to an engine burn that is.
The staging stack icon displays the state of each parachute. The \ncolor of the background shows how safe it is to stage. The icon's \ncolor shows the state of the staged chute.
Just keep in mind that not all the places you visit have atmosphere.
